title: Accepting a command completion inserts only 'name: ' — required-option metadata the provider already has is never scaffolded, and commands have no documentation hover
existing_state: ScriptAutocompleteProvider hand-maintains RequiredOptionKeysByCommand for 35 commands — e.g. sftp requires action/local_path/remote_path, extract requires from/pattern/into (Services/Editor/ScriptAutocompleteProvider.cs:180-217) — but this data is only used to badge and sort option keys in a later popup. Accepting a command inserts the bare key plus ': ' (BuildCompletionInsertText, UI/ScintillaScriptEditorControl.cs:1365-1386); the user must then recall and type each required option, triggering autocomplete once per key. Command descriptions are terse 1-3 word strings ('Selection', 'Case match' — ScriptAutocompleteProvider.cs:116-161) drawn right-aligned in the popup and hidden entirely when width is tight, and the dwell tooltip covers only diagnostics and variables — hovering a command name shows nothing (Editor_DwellStart, UI/ScintillaScriptEditorControl.cs:810-844). The hand-maintained maps have also already drifted: the parser knows 14 top-level keys including 'preconnect' (Services/Scripting/ScriptParser.cs:70-86) but TopLevelKeyDescriptions has 13 — preconnect appears in the list with no description (ScriptAutocompleteProvider.cs:163-178).
recommendation: (1) Snippet scaffolding: when a StepCommand completion is accepted, expand RequiredOptionKeysByCommand into an indented body ('- sftp:' newline '    action: ' newline '    local_path: ' ...) and place the caret at the first value — the Enter-accept path already chains a Smart Enter (UI/ScintillaScriptEditorControl.cs:911-926), so this replaces that chain for commands with required options; make it a CommandEditorSettings toggle. (2) Add a StepCommand branch to ResolveVariableTooltip/Editor_DwellStart that shows the command description plus its required/optional keys on hover. (3) While there, single-source the metadata: move descriptions and required-key lists next to ScriptParser's KnownStepKeys/KnownTopLevelKeys so a new command registered in the parser cannot silently lack editor metadata (fixes the existing preconnect drift).
user_benefit: New users stop guessing YAML shapes ('what does sftp need again?') and power users author steps in one accept instead of four autocomplete round-trips. Single-sourcing also stops the editor quietly falling behind every time a script command is added.

evidence.note: Required options per command already encoded but unused at insert time
Dwell tooltip covers diagnostics + variables only; no command help
TopLevelKeyDescriptions missing 'preconnect' vs ScriptParser.cs:70-86 — proof the hand-maintained maps drift

mockup_idea: Before/after: left shows today — popup accepts 'sftp', buffer reads '- sftp: ' with a blinking caret and nothing else; right shows the accepted snippet '- sftp:' with 'action: ', 'local_path: ', 'remote_path: ' pre-indented beneath, caret on the action value, plus a small hover card over 'sftp' reading 'SFTP transfer — required: action, local_path, remote_path'.
